The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for an order of pre- arrest bail.

2. The petitioners are the accused 1 and 2 in crime No.1725/2023 of the Kottiyam Police Station,
Kollam, registered against them for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 120B, 511, 420 r/w. Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Heard; Sri. Manu Ramachandran, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and Smt.
Neema T.V., the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondents and Sri.K.V.Anil Kumar,
the learned counsel appearing for the defacto complainant/intervenor.
4.

After bestowing my anxious consideration to the materials placed on record, particularly taking note of Annexure A3 FIR lodged by the petitioners against the defacto complainant and the present Annexure A1 FIR, I am of the definite view that the petitioners' custodial interrogation is not necessary.
Nonetheless, they shall make themselves available before the investigating officer for interrogation and the proper investigation of the crime.
Hence, I deem it appropriate to pass an interim order, which will do complete justice to both sides.
5. In the result, the petitioners are directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within one week from today for subjecting themselves for interrogation.

After interrogation and in the event of petitioners' arrest, they shall be released on bail on executing separate bond for Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees one lakh only) with two solvent sureties each to the like sum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
This order shall remain in force for a period of two weeks.

Sd/-
